meta: A small café has no marketing team, but AI can take over some daily paperwork: writing the menu in two languages, planning stock, and drafting replies to reviews.

muc.title: A small café using AI
muc.text: A small café has no marketing team, but it can ask AI to take over some of the daily paperwork.

muc.title: Write a tempting menu
muc.text: Give AI the dish names, ingredients and what makes each special, and ask for short menu descriptions, including an English version for foreign guests.

muc.title: Estimate ingredients
muc.text: Paste last month's daily cup sales and ask AI which days are busy and which drinks sell best, so you buy just enough milk and pastries.

muc.title: Reply to customer reviews
muc.text: When a customer complains online, ask AI for a polite draft reply, then add your own sincere apology.

muc.title: A menu card for the counter
muc.text: Pick three best-selling items, ask AI for menu descriptions in two languages, then print a small card for the counter.
